text:
emma: Heads-up — planning to roll v2 to production tomorrow 2026-03-22 09:00 UTC. Start with a small canary slice, carve out known fragile tenants and mobile SDKs for the first 30m. Ops-eyes appreciated.

raj: +1. Which tenants are you carving out?

emma: carving out: tenant:acme, tenant:legacy-api, tenant:edge-mobile. Will add them to pinlist before deploy.

sophia: Any release-notes copy we should post to customers about client header normalization changes? want to avoid surprise.

emma: short note planned: "v2 normalizes api-client-version header case; older SDKs may send legacy.case — we will fallback to v1 for those clients for 48h while they update." I'll paste final before cutover.

ops-lee: Can we get rollback/stop criteria spelled out here? ops will be on-call during window.

emma: rollback triggers: 
- sustained 5xx rate > 0.5% cluster-wide for 5m
- p95 latency increase > 2x baseline for 10m
- canary tenant errors for pinned tenants > 1% for 5m
If any trigger, ops to hit the deploybot `stop` and we rollback to v1.

ben: What's the canary ramp plan and telemetry gates?

emma: plan: 5% traffic for 15m -> 20% for 15m -> 50% for 10m -> full. Telemetry gates: error-rate and p95. We'll also watch function-call traces for any schema rejects.

raj: Please confirm client pinlist commands so deploybot picks it up.

emma: adding pinlist now. deploybot command (will run in prod channel):
```
/deploy schedule --stack api-v2 --start 2026-03-22T09:00:00Z \
  --canary 5,20,50 --canary-durations 15m,15m,10m \
  --pinlist tenant:acme,tenant:legacy-api,tenant:edge-mobile \
  --fallback-route v1-mux --notify ops-team
```

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy: api-v2 starting 2026-03-22T09:00:00Z. Canary steps [5%,20%,50%]. Pinlist detected: tenant:acme, tenant:legacy-api, tenant:edge-mobile. Notifying ops-team.

ops-lee: I'll be on rotation at 08:30-11:30 UTC. ops runbook link: https://internal/runbooks/api-rollout.

ben: Suggest adding an infra-only quiesce window right before full traffic (5m) to let KV caches settle after canary change.

emma: good call — adding 5m quiesce before final flip. deploybot flag will be `--quiesce 5m`.

raj: Any clients using streaming where we should extend KV cache warmup? mobile streaming is flaky.

emma: mobile streaming clients are in carveout; edge-mobile pinned to v1. We'll re-evaluate after 48h.

sophia: I'll draft the release note and put it in #marketing-release-drafts for approval. Short blurb + mitigation steps for SDKs.

deploy-bot: Preflight checks: model-compat OK, schema-tests: passed, infra-health: green, canary-seed inject: ready.

ops-lee: Confirming alerting thresholds in onboarding dashboard: error-rate alert at 0.5% and p95 latency at 2x baseline — I set a pager.

ben: If we need hot rollback, do we have a quick route to drain new shards? How long to restore v1 stable path?

emma: rollback path is instant route-swap to v1 variant; expected <30s for API routing propagation. We'll run a test swap in staging tomorrow at 06:00 UTC to validate.

raj: One more ask: can we keep a short-lived header `X-RW-Rollout=api-v2` for 2h after full rollout so we can trace regressions per client?

emma: yes — adding header flag to deploy: `--trace-rollout-header X-RW-Rollout=api-v2:2h`. will include in release notes.

sophia: ack on release notes draft, will update once emma sends final.

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: deploy api-v2 in 20h. Use `/deploy cancel <id>` to cancel.

emma: thanks everyone — posting final pinlist and release-note draft in this thread by EOD. ops, please confirm you'll be watching the canary metrics. :thumbsup:

ops-lee: watching. :eyes:

last: (automated) deploy-bot heartbeat check at 6519876634: preflight still green.
